 Who is Surekha Vani? Telugu actress' Instagram account hacked, issues warning over circulation of private content
 SECTIONS Who is Surekha Vani? Telugu actress' Instagram account hacked, issues warning over circulation of private content By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 08, 2026, 09:54:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Actress Surekha Vani has taken to social media to announce that her Instagram account has been compromised, leading to the unauthorised distribution of her private content. She has called upon users and media outlets to cease sharing this content. To protect her privacy, Vani is prepared to initiate legal proceedings against anyone who continues to circulate these materials.
 Surekha Vani's Instagram account hacked (Credit: Instagram) Telugu actress Surekha Vani has recently raised concerns after claiming that her Instagram account was hacked and her private content was circulated online without her consent. The actress has now issued a warning to social media users, meme pages and media platforms, asking them not to share or repost the material. She has also threatened legal action against anyone found spreading her personal content.
 Surekha Vani's Instagram account hacked
Taking to Instagram, Surekha Vani shared a statement addressing the alleged breach of her privacy. She said that her account had been hacked and that her personal content was being circulated without her permission.
The actress wrote, "I am clearly asking everyone - including meme pages, media/ press platforms, YouTube channels and individuals - to STOP sharing, reposting, uploading or circulating this content in any form.
Any account or person found sharing, publishing, or further spreading my private content will be identified, documented and legal action will be taken against them.

 Please do not take advantage of this
 situation for views, reach or publicity.
 Respect my privacy. This is a serious matter and I will not hesitate to take legal action."
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Surekhavani (@artist_surekhavani) 
 The actress's statement comes amid concerns over the circulation of personal content on social media. While she has spoken about her Instagram account being hacked, she has not shared further details about the incident or the people responsible.
 Who is Surekha Vani?
Surekha Vani is a familiar face in Telugu cinema and is known for her comic timing and supporting performances. She has appeared in more than 100 films across Telugu and Tamil cinema, often playing characters that audiences easily recognise in family dramas and entertainers.
Before entering films, Surekha began her career as a television anchor for a local cable channel. She gradually moved into acting and established herself as a character artist in the Telugu film industry.
Over the years, she has been part of several popular films, including Bhadra, Dookudu, Seethamma Vakitlo Sirimalle Chettu, Race Gurram and Srimanthudu. She also appeared in Tamil films such as Mersal and Master.
Her performances have largely been in supporting roles, where she has portrayed mothers, aunts and other family members. Her screen presence and comic performances have helped her build a steady career in the industry.
Born in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, Surekha Vani was married to television director Suresh Teja. He passed away in 2019.
The actress has a daughter, Supritha Naidu, who is also active on social media. The mother-daughter duo often shares pictures and videos together, and their online presence has made them familiar to many followers.
